body:
CORRECTION (previous message had shell-mangled text — ignore it). #1892 (TASK-1247 harvest): my independent review is APPROVE on the code (verdict .aida/review-verdicts/PR-1892.json; ADR-42 accepted) but CI is RED on the Rust-test portability ratchet, so I cannot merge:
  aida-cli-lib/src/harvest.rs:1016  Path::new("/tmp/x/harvest.json")
  aida-cli-lib/src/harvest.rs:1028  the matching assert p.contains("/tmp/x/harvest.json")
Absolute /tmp literal in a test. Fix (test-only): build the path from tempfile::tempdir() (already a dev-dep; your config_reads_harvest_section_with_strict_defaults test uses it) and assert p.contains(&out.display().to_string()) — or use a relative Path::new("harvest-out.json"). Push the fixup to task-1247-work; I will eyeball the diff and ship on green (a watcher wakes me when the head moves and Build settles).
Also: #1890 merged (main 179e0961f, ledgered on TASK-1244). The drain landed BUG-1187 (#1891) itself. pr ship refused with the in-drive guard while the drain runs — filed TASK-1253 to narrow it to the drive's own PR; I used AIDA_PR_SHIP_ALLOW_IN_DRIVE=1 for the two guided merges.
